frame.note: drawing frame: origin at the part's bounding-box corner; Z = sheet normal (flat) or the smallest extent; X the longer of the other two. Datum C = the x = 0 edge, B = the y = 0 edge, A = the z = 0 face.

bend_edge.quote: Bend-to-edge tolerance: +/- 0.015″ (each additional bend adds at least 0.015″)

flat.source: mechloop class value (tolerance/process.py sheet flat, 2 standard deviations); SendCutSend publishes none for this

predictions.finding: y_plate_left: 4 hole(s) or cut-out(s) narrower than the 4.75 mm sheet (smallest 3.50 mm at [-170.0, -51.61, 419.38]): they cut, but taper and lose accuracy.
y_plate_left: 3 hole(s) with less than 4.75 mm of material to the edge (least 3.35 mm at [-181.33, -27.86, 419.38]): the web overheats and distorts, and tears if the part is bent or loaded.
y_plate_left: 3 pair(s) of holes or cut-outs with too little material between them (least 3.50 mm at [-133.0, -41.61, 419.38], wanted 4.75 mm = 1 x thickness).

y_plate_left: SendCutSend rule sendcutsend.cut.hole_min_al6061_page: smallest hole or cut-out 3.5 mm (4 of 10), limit >= 4.75 mm (warning: the supplier's words: "Design holes no smaller than material thickness.").

y_plate_left: SendCutSend rule sendcutsend.cut.hole_edge_al6061_page: hole edge to part edge 3.75 mm (1 of 4), limit >= 7.12 mm (warning: the supplier's words: "Keep holes and cutouts 1.5–2× material thickness away from edges to prevent warping or distortion.").
